gold_laws.GL2: No autonomous self-modification. JARVIS proposes, Raven commits or rejects. No agent rewrites its own identity, rules, or constraints.
gold_laws.GL5: No silent state mutation. Every state change must emit a BUS event and be logged. Nothing changes invisibly.
gold_laws.GL6: No unvalidated execution. AEGIS gates all emulator starts and high-risk actions. Validation before execution, always.
gold_laws.GL7: No expansion without simplification. Supreme constraint. overlap_score must be below 0.40. Every new system reduces complexity elsewhere.
gold_laws.GL9: All actions must map intent→decision→execution→log. Traceability is mandatory. No action without a record.

architecture_decisions.cloud_first: Cloud-first stack only. No Ollama, no local-PC-dependent services. GitHub + Supabase + Claude Code + Codex. Permanent direction.
architecture_decisions.god_systems_fixed: 27 God Systems are fixed. Do not redefine, renumber, or add. Full contracts in memory/chaos/chaos_seed.json.
architecture_decisions.grid_tron_split: GRID = internal state kernel (read-only). TRON = navigation/UI shell. Do not blur this boundary. Per P00 and P23.
architecture_decisions.mnemos_structural: Structural tagger only — no external embeddings. Vocab in mnemos_vocab table. Adding a tag = one INSERT, no deploy.
architecture_decisions.repo_as_brain: GitHub repo files = JARVIS structured knowledge base. Supabase = hot/searchable layer. Both together = full library.

companion_decisions.all_four_gaps_active: All 4 companion gaps confirmed active by Raven 2026-05-28: session brief, challenge layer, autonomous initiation, deeper profile.
companion_decisions.jarvis_priority: JARVIS is the priority. GameBoy page is secondary. Build GitHub + Supabase + JARVIS itself together every step.
